name: session-keeper
description: Restart your Mac, iTerm2 or a single Claude Code session without losing windows or conversations: snapshot windows, tabs, tmux sessions and Claude session ids, then reopen and resume them.

folder_title.title: Put the folder at the start of session titles
folder_title.description: on: a SessionStart hook renames sessions to '<folder> · <title>', handy when many sessions are open or on a phone through Remote Control.
